project.name: Inductra Vaion
project.author: Vaishnav
project.description: A real-time electromagnetic diagnostic instrument. It reads a [[QMC5883P three-axis magnetometer]] and three [[electric-field probe]] channels through an [[Arduino Uno]], resolves them into [[magnetic vectors]] and [[relative E-field activity]], and measures how far each sits from its own environment.

sources.note: firmware/inductra_uno_bridge.ino on an Uno plugged into this machine
the same Uno on a Mac, forwarded by bridge/uno_network_bridge.py --host <this machine>
tinySA is read by Inductra's own driver, not a line protocol; POST {"source":"rf","values":{"RF_DEV_DB":x}} to /mtdi/ingest

rules.text: Magnetic activity with weak electric activity suggests a nearby current loop or conductor. Probe sensitivity and geometry can also explain the difference.
Electric activity with weak magnetic activity suggests capacitive coupling or a voltage driven source. This is a relative probe comparison.
A spectrum change with weak low frequency activity suggests an RF source. Antenna coupling and a swept scan do not establish source location or protocol.

aether.purpose: Aether is the soul layer. It is not a sensor or a formula. It is the part of Inductra Vaion created by failure, obsession, rebuilding and the need to make the invisible visible.
story: MTDI makes it stand. I³ makes it beautiful. NVTRA makes it speak. Aether makes it alive.
authorship: I selected the sensors. I designed the diagnostic structure. I created MTDI. I defined I³. I integrated the Pi and the dashboard logic. I tested the sensor behaviour. I shaped the purpose. I made the decisions. I carried the idea.
AI helped me build faster, but it did not dream this for me. This came from me.
aether.quote: It started as induction. It became interference. Now it is intelligence.

home_opening.title: Electromagnetic interference is unwanted electromagnetic energy that flows into other systems.
home_opening.tagline: It leaks from motors, chargers, radios and wiring, rides along cables and through the air, and disturbs whatever it reaches. Inductra Vaion measures it as magnetic, electric and radio-frequency energy, so you can see where it comes from and how strong it is.
